## Activity

During June 2023, East City Eye Clinic recorded 211 captures. This provides the activity total for the reporting period and reflects the volume processed by the clinic team. The activity record is presented as a straightforward count of captures completed at the site during the month.

## Image quality

Image quality outcomes included 2 ungradable captures. The ungradable rate was 0.9. Together, these figures describe the proportion and number of captures that could not be graded. The rate is reported alongside the count to provide a clear view of image quality performance for June 2023 at East City Eye Clinic.

## Grading

Grading identified 47 referable results during the reporting period. The median lag from capture to grading was 2. This records the central turnaround measure for the site and places the referable result count in the context of the grading activity completed during June 2023. The figures provide the available summary of activity, image quality, and grading performance for East City Eye Clinic.
